senses.gloss: to join, attach. Y. Nidd. II, end, 50ᵇ ולא הוה מְצָרֵף לון עימיה and never joined them to himself (invited them to a consultation); חד זמן צָרְפוֹן עימיה once he did invite them; בגין כן צָרְפִיתְכוֹן (not צריפתכון) therefore I invited you; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 53a">B. Mets. 53ᵃ</cite>, v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>מְצָרַף</he>.
Sot. 17ᵃ האי מצ׳ והאי לא מצ׳ in the word אִשָּׁה the Alef and Shin (אֵשׁ fire) are joined, in אִישׁ, they are not joined (separated by י; Rashi: מִיצְּרִיף Ithpe.).

senses.gloss: (denom. of צְרִיפְתָּא) to mix earth with alum. Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 53a:5">B. Mets. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִצְטַרְפִינְהוּ</he> (Rashi <he>ונִיצְרַף</he>; Ms. M. <he>ונִצְרוֹף</he>; Ms. H. <he>ונְצָרֵיף</he>; Ms. F. <he>ונִצִטְרַף</he>) let them (the two kinds of coins) be joined (and treated as one mass; Rashi a. Mss.: let him join them); <he>דאורייתא … לא מִצְטָרְפֵי</he> things forbidden as sacred by Biblical law and things forbidden by rabbinical law cannot be combined (Ms. H. <he>לא מְצָרְפִינָן</he> we dare not combine).

<cite ref="Sukkah 19a:14-16">Succ. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>מי … דאִיצְטָרוּפֵי מצטרף וכ׳</he> is there anything that may be joined (to make up the legal size) which in itself is not fit? <cite ref="Berakhot 47a:12">Ber. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי דעתך לאיצטרופי בהדן</he> do you expect to be counted with us (as the third person for saying grace)? <cite ref="Yoma 74a:7">Yoma 74ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי לאיצטרופי</he> fit to be added (to make up the legal quantity); a. fr.—
